endangerment.comment: Romanian Sign Language (rms-rms) = 5 (Developing). Recognized language (2006, Legea nr. 448/2006), in the context of general disability legislation. Recognized language (2020, Decret nr. 213/2020, 2020-03-27), as the mother-tongue of Romanian deaf, from a linguistic/cultural perspective.

classification.sub: A Central European sign language is borne out by lexical comparison (**hh:h:Bickford:EEurope**) and is consistent with historical information (**hh:h:Woll:Global-Sign**:28, **hh:h:Rutkowski:Eastern-Europe**:796).
